bibliography.title: Missing Mass for Differentially Private Domain Discovery

sections.title: B Privacy Analysis of Peeling Exponential Mechanism

abstract_sentences.text: We study several problems in differentially private domain discovery, where each user holds a subset of items from a shared but unknown domain, and the goal is to output an informative subset of items.

evidence.anchor: We study several problems in differentially private domain discovery

abstract_sentences.text: For set union, we show that the simple baseline Weighted Gaussian Mechanism (WGM) has a near-optimal ℓ1 missing mass guarantee on Zipfian data as well as a distribution-free ℓ∞ missing mass guarantee.

evidence.anchor: near-optimal ℓ1 missing mass guarantee on Zipfian data

abstract_sentences.text: We then apply the WGM as a domain-discovery precursor for existing known-domain algorithms for private top-k and k-hitting set and obtain new utility guarantees for their unknown domain variants.

evidence.anchor: apply the WGM as a domain-discovery precursor

abstract_sentences.text: Finally, experiments demonstrate that all of our WGM-based methods are competitive with or outperform existing baselines for all three problems.

evidence.anchor: competitive with or outperform existing baselines for all three problems

final_judgment.single_storyline: 将未知域 DP domain discovery 从 cardinality 重构为 frequency-weighted missing mass；证明 WGM 的 ℓ1/ℓ∞ 接口，再组合到 unknown-domain top-k 与 k-hitting set。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 soundness、Zipfian 条件、WGM/Meta/peeling 方法、Theorems 3.3/3.5/3.6/4.3/4.5、上下界、隐私预算和 Figures 1–3。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 集中不等式、完整 WGM/peeling/User Peeling proof、lower bounds、Table 1、Zipf/ECDF diagnostics、低 ε/ordered ℓ1 结果移入 Appendix A–F。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 式(1)统一 ℓp missing mass；式(2)分离 subsampling/thresholding；Theorem 3.6 的 ℓ∞接口让同一 WGM 前置器复用于两项下游任务。
final_judgment.largest_gap: simple/scalable 只有定性计算证据；无 runtime、seed、完整 config 或 Supplement code；top-k/k-hitting 上下界未匹配，ℓ∞ 无直接实验指标。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 先定义可与下游目标相加的频率加权域损失，证明可组合的 ℓ∞/tail 接口，再明确隐私预算和每阶段误差来源地接入多个 known-domain solver。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 要求 soundness、遗漏频率能控制下游损失且任务允许 domain truncation；pure DP、非 sound 输出、runtime 保证或 matched lower bound 超出本文证据。
